|strategy=By Carl 'Mike' Hardy, Red 32<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/dark/small/ewebblaster.html</ref>

Oh, my, what a big gun you have...

This is one of the many new artillery weapons that were introduced in The Empire Strikes Back: [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] expansion. But this is the only one for the Dark Side.

There are a lot of good things about this artillery weapon. One is that if you happen to lose the character that's firing it, you don't have to lose the weapon (unlike normal character weapons, the E-web is depoyed to a site, thus isn't lost along with the hapless character). Another is that any warrior, that just happens to be at the same site at the same time, can fire the thing (none of that redeploy business). Finally, this thing is powerful, really powerful, and can be used against a number of different targets; character, vehicle OR starship.

Best of all... It's a [[Blaster]]! So, give this to a Trooper, play [[Blasted Droid]] and watch the Millenium [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] go up in flames!

A drawback is the fact that it has to be powered. That means you've gotta get yourself a 'Gonk' ([[EG-6 (Eegee-Six){{!}}EG-6]] (see my later card extra about this fella!)) or a [[Portable Fusion Generator]]. Now, neither of these power sources are bad, provided you've got your deck tailored so that they fit nicely. For instance, 'Gonk' really does a good job when it's with other droids (and believe me, the Dark Side's got plenty of droids). And the [[Portable Fusion Generator]] gives you that nice cozzy +1 to weapon destiny. Another drawback is its high deploy. Well, what do you expect from a big gun anyway? Besides, it does have forfiet, so you can lose the gun instead of a more valuable character.
